name: flower-marketplace-platform
description: Production-grade full-stack multi-vendor fresh flower e-commerce platform with AI-powered floral & logistics intelligence

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install

scripts.type-check: npm --prefix server run type-check && npm --prefix client run type-check
